UmaDesktopPet modification notice:
The Furniture Kit's `table` model is copied into the app-owned source tree and
is the active runtime source. It is imported as static 3D geometry, narrowed and
rescaled for the desktop-pet composition, and its source material is replaced
by the app-owned Tachyon laboratory palette at runtime. No backboard, canopy,
or other Furniture Kit model is added to the scene. No endorsement by Kenney is
implied.
